context_en: You and your close friend Sam meet up at your favorite neighborhood coffee shop on a sunny Saturday afternoon.
context_fa: شما و دوست صمیمیتان سَم در یک بعدازظهر آفتابی شنبه در کافه همیشگی محله برای نوشیدن قهوه دیدار کرده‌اید.
initial_message_en: Hey! It feels like ages since we caught up properly. How have you been holding up with work and everything?
initial_message_fa: سلام! خیلی وقته درست و حسابی با هم حرف نزدیم. اوضاع کار و زندگی چطور پیش میره؟

goals.description_en: Share how you've been doing or mention a recent hobby/project
goals.description_fa: از احوال خود یا یک فعالیت/پروژه جدید که اخیراً انجام داده‌اید بگویید

goals.description_en: Inquire about Sam's week, plans, or family
goals.description_fa: درباره هفته، برنامه‌ها یا حال و روز سَم سوال بپرسید

goals.description_en: Suggest doing an activity together (movie, hike, concert, or dinner)
goals.description_fa: پیشنهاد یک فعالیت مشترک برای آخر هفته بدهید

target_vocabulary.definition: To talk to someone you have not seen for a while to find out what each person has been doing
Full of incessant or frantic activity; very busy
To relax after a period of work or tension
Performed or occurring as a result of a sudden impulse without premeditation

suggested_prompts: I've been quite busy building an AI language learning app, but it's really exciting!
How have things been on your end? Are you still planning that trip to Vancouver?
We should definitely go hiking in the nature reserve tomorrow to unwind!
